items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers the failed indoor supply pipe, and §7.1.7(c) covers like-for-like pipe, seals and insulation. The comparable material lines in Case 39 total at least €190 gross, supporting €200 for the single billed package.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary trade labour for the repair. The invoice bills one flat rate rather than an hourly quantity, so the supplied €76 unit benchmark is applied once.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice, regardless of the number of visits. One billed charge at €81 gross gives €81.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per drying operation. One flat-rate deployment at the €439 benchmark gives €439 gross.

items.description: Close and repaint the wall opening
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(a) covers making good the necessary access opening, and §7.1.5 confines the work to the affected area. One localized closure and repainting at the €453 benchmark gives €453 gross.
